title: Lemongrass Chicken Pasta
description: A twist on traditional Italian pasta with the addition of lemongrass and spices, creating an aromatic and flavorful dish.
instructions: Cook the penne pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the lemongrass and sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the garlic to the skillet and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes and Indian dal spice paste to the skillet. Stir to combine and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir to combine with the tomato and dal sauce.
Add the cooked penne pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the chicken and sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
